name: tavo-ui-monorepo
description: Public monorepo for Tavo.js UI and React Native packages.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @tavojs/ui-core && npm run build --workspace @tavojs/ui-cli && npm run build --workspace @tavojs/ui && npm run build --workspace @tavojs/ui-react-native
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace @tavojs/ui-core && npm run build --workspace @tavojs/ui-cli && npm run build --workspace @tavojs/ui
scripts.pack:dry: npm pack --dry-run --workspace @tavojs/ui-core && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @tavojs/ui-cli && npm run pack:dry --workspace @tavojs/ui && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @tavojs/ui-react-native
scripts.test: npm run check:framework-contract && npm test --workspace @tavojs/ui-core && npm test --workspace @tavojs/ui-cli && npm test --workspace @tavojs/ui && npm test --workspace @tavojs/ui-react-native
scripts.test:web: npm run check:framework-contract && npm test --workspace @tavojs/ui-core && npm test --workspace @tavojs/ui-cli && npm test --workspace @tavojs/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @tavojs/ui-core && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.typecheck:web: npm run build --workspace @tavojs/ui-core && npm run typecheck --workspace @tavojs/ui-core && npm run typecheck --workspace @tavojs/ui-cli && npm run typecheck --workspace @tavojs/ui
scripts.release:check:web: npm run release:manifest && npm run release:audit && npm run check:framework-contract && npm test --workspace @tavojs/ui-core && npm test --workspace @tavojs/ui-cli && npm run release:check --workspace @tavojs/ui && npm run release:pack:web
scripts.release:check: npm run release:check:web && npm run release:check:native
scripts.release:check:native: npm run typecheck --workspace @tavojs/ui-react-native && npm test --workspace @tavojs/ui-react-native && npm run smoke:consumer --workspace @tavojs/ui-react-native && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @tavojs/ui-react-native
scripts.release:pack:web: npm pack --dry-run --workspace @tavojs/ui-core && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @tavojs/ui-cli && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @tavojs/ui
